item.title: Sale of Roger Williams, Fatima hospitals finalized
item.description: Rhode Island Gov. Dan McKee and Attorney General Peter Neronha, along with legislative and health care leaders, held a news conference Friday to mark the sale of the two hospitals to Centurion Foundation, a Georgia-based nonprofit.

item.title: 'Our go-to spot': PC students, longtime patrons saddened by loss of Bradley Cafe
item.description: A bar that's been serving generations of Providence College students and other patrons has been deemed a total loss after a fire Friday morning.

item.title: Man arrested after allegedly threatening Providence police chief
item.description: A man has been charged with disorderly conduct and threatening a public official after a car crash with Providence Police Chief Oscar Perez on Friday, according to a spokesperson for the police department.
